title: Known hosts
tooltip: The first time you reach a server its host key is shown and you decide whether to trust it. After that, a changed key is refused outright rather than silently accepted — this is what protects you from a swapped-out or spoofed server. Forget a host here to be asked again.
description: Host keys trusted via the connect-time confirmation prompt. Forgetting one means the next connection to that host re-prompts.
